governing_question: Can this signal earn and keep the right to influence capital allocation?

steps.purpose: Freeze the simple just-passed legislative interpretation rule before historical or prospective evaluation.
completion_criteria: canonical hypothesis is frozen
entry, exit, benchmark, costs, invalidation and out-of-sample boundary are defined
real-money trading remains unauthorized

steps.purpose: Lock a diverse historical case universe before reviewing outcomes.
completion_criteria: at least 24 cases are selected and locked
all required event categories are represented
all required case types are represented
case selection precedes post-event outcome review

steps.purpose: Reconstruct each case using only information available at the declared cutoff.
completion_criteria: every selected case has a point-in-time packet
source publication timestamps are preserved
input packet hashes validate
no post-cutoff prices or retrospective articles are present

steps.purpose: Generate and seal policy-impact memos before outcomes are visible.
completion_criteria: every reconstructed case has a versioned sealed memo
beneficiaries, losers, no-trade conclusions, mechanism, materiality, timing, benchmark and invalidation are recorded
memo hashes validate and original versions are preserved

steps.purpose: Reveal market, operating and explanatory evidence only after the memo is sealed.
completion_criteria: 1, 5, 20 and 60-session outcomes are recorded
after-cost benchmark-adjusted returns are recorded
mainstream, trade-publication and niche reporting are stored in the reveal packet
outcome packet hashes validate

steps.purpose: Score legal interpretation separately from market usefulness.
completion_criteria: interpretation accuracy is scored from 0 to 100
investment usefulness is scored independently from 0 to 100
attribution review distinguishes law effects from competing explanations
no single case grants capital rights

steps.purpose: Use the resulting errors to improve later framework versions without rewriting prior results.
completion_criteria: errors are assigned to a predeclared taxonomy
each revision cites source cases
original memos and scores remain unchanged
framework changes receive a new version and apply prospectively

steps.purpose: Begin untouched prospective testing on newly passed legislation after historical comprehension is demonstrated.
completion_criteria: historical readiness gate passes
prospective activation timestamp is frozen before eligible legislation
every prospective case is captured without outcome knowledge
paper research only; no real-money authorization

historical_readiness_gate.purpose: Permit untouched prospective research, not capital deployment.
required_case_types: second-order supplier, customer or competitor effect
